sn12.14:1.2: Any recluses or brahmins, Monks, who do not know these things, do not know the uprising of them, the ceasing of them, the way leading to their ceasing—which things is it they do not know [in this fourfold way]?
sn12.14:2.13: those recluses or brahmins are approved neither among recluses as recluses, nor among brahmins as brahmins. Nor have those venerable ones understood of themselves, nor realized what is the good of being a recluse or o brahmin, nor lived in the attainment thereof.
sn12.14:3.1: But those recluses or brahmins, Monks, who know these things—which things is it they know?
sn12.14:4.11: activities in their nature, their uprising, their ceasing.
sn12.14:4.12: the way going to their ceasing—
sn12.14:4.13: those recluses or brahmins are approved both among recluses as recluses and among brahmins as brahmins. And those venerable ones have understood of themselves, have realized what is the good of being a recluse and a brahmin, and have lived in the attainment thereof even in this present life.
